identity.title: Complete remaining MVVM ownership boundaries after repository audit

origin.kind: 2026-08-19 owner-requested whole-repository MVVM audit and documentation handoff
origin.summary: The audit found that PL-0025 completed several concrete extractions but overclaimed repository-wide MVVM completion. The owner requested durable documentation before continuing with a lower-cost model.

state.current_summary: M1 audit and documentation, M2 Results/Validation child ViewModel ownership, M3 Source Quality smoke extraction, and M4a/M4b/M4c/M4d Height Deviation rule/Preview ownership are complete with focused structure/build evidence. M5 filter-tool-family extraction has first-pass build/hygiene verification. M6 Tool Lab lifecycle deduplication is complete.
state.next_action: Complete M5 criterion checks across remaining Workbench execution families, then execute final M7 qualification (focused checks, refreshed structure/ownership verification, Release build, git diff --check, and required dependency/DLL-policy confirmation) before next acceptance handoff.

objective.summary: Finish the remaining MVVM and maintainability boundaries with independently verifiable concrete owners while preserving public Viewer hosting and all explicit inspection-action contracts.
constraints: Preserve explicit Preview, Publish, Run, Validation, source/result separation, stable identities, and no-execution presentation actions.
Move responsibility and state to independent concrete owners; do not treat partial-file movement or delegating wrappers as completion.
Keep View code-behind limited to dialogs, WPF/OpenGL/pointer/docking adapters, and thin request wiring.
Use one lower-cost-model milestone at a time and split Viewer recipes and Workbench tool execution by coherent owner rather than attempting a big-bang rewrite.
Do not add a DI container, mediator, event bus, speculative interfaces, empty category folders, or a lib folder without an accepted DLL-only dependency.
Preserve the existing dirty worktree and do not commit or push without explicit owner authorization.

criteria.text: Owning documents and the issue ledger describe the audit correction, exact remaining owners, low-cost-model slice order, and non-overclaim completion rule.
Results and Validation navigation state and commands are owned by child ViewModels; the Views bind and render without directly mutating the screen state.
MainWindow retains WPF composition and callback wiring while command-line smoke scenario policy, capture helpers, and verification orchestration have independent Verification/Smoke owners.

Viewer recipe validation, load/apply, save, direct rule execution, and Preview orchestration are owned outside OpenVisionThreeDViewerControl while dialogs, rendering, pointer behavior, and public host compatibility remain intact.

Workbench execution state is split into independently testable concrete owners by coherent tool family, and ToolWorkbenchViewModel no longer directly owns each moved cancellation, running, stale, output, published, validation, and Tool execution path.
Repeated Tool Lab selected-step and window-lifecycle behavior has one bounded owner, and verification code uses explicit verification boundaries without changing supported smoke entry contracts.

Every milestone proves former-owner removal with focused checks and regression guards; final structure verification, Release build, diff hygiene, DLL policy, and required refreshed R0 validation pass.

evidence.observation: Whole-repository inspection found the remaining View workflow, large partial-owner, MainWindow smoke, View navigation-state, Tool Lab duplication, and compiled-verification boundaries while the current structure guard passed 49/49, Release build passed with zero warnings and errors, git diff --check passed, and no tracked or loose DLL required lib/.

The refactor plan, master backlog, next-session handoff, PL-0025 historical record, and PL-0026 current ledger agree that repository-wide MVVM completion remains open, that M2 is the only next implementation slice, and that gpt-5.6-terra with medium reasoning is the bounded continuation recommendation.

PL-0026 M2 moved ResultsWorkspaceSection and ValidationWorkspaceSection state, selection commands, validation filter reset, and failure-sample correction into child ViewModels. XAML radio state and content visibility bind to those owners through CheckedCommandBehavior; the Views retain only WPF layout and thin request adapters. Release Shell build passed 0 warnings and 0 errors; Workbench Docking passed 87/87; Validation Set passed 84/84; structure guard passed 49/49; git diff --check passed. Current-build Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 closest-baseline/Reports screenshots passed screenshot quality on the selected left smaller monitor DISPLAY2 (bounds -1920,365,1920,1080). The baseline captures are explicitly closest reproducible baselines, not true pre-edit captures.

PL-0026 M3 moved the Source Quality workspace smoke readiness wait, view-only/no-execution assertions, and report serialization from MainWindow.xaml.cs into Verification/Smoke/ShellSourceQualitySmoke.cs; MainWindow retains invocation and failure callback wiring. Structure guard passed 51/51; Source Quality ViewModel passed 18/18; Workbench Docking passed 87/87; Validation Set passed 84/84; Shell and solution Release builds passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors; current-build exact-source Source Quality EXE smoke passed Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 with screenshot quality accepted on attempt 1 and both reports recording viewOnly=true, recipeChanged=false, inspectionRun=false. The separate asynchronous same-source loader timing report recorded zero dispatcher ticks and was not used as the M3 acceptance gate. git diff --check passed after the documentation update.

PL-0026 M4a moved Height Deviation recipe-relative source resolution, C3D grid loading, and existing Height Deviation rule preparation from OpenVisionThreeDViewerControl.Recipes.cs into the non-WPF Recipes/HeightDeviationRecipeLoadPlan.cs typed owner. The View consumes the plan and retains state/render application. Viewer recipe load-plan verification passed 6/6, structure guard passed 52/52, Workbench Docking passed 87/87, Validation Set passed 84/84, Shell and solution Release builds passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, and current-build recipe-load EXE screenshots passed Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 with screenshot quality accepted on attempt 1. Missing source rejection passed. git diff --check passed. This is an M4a checkpoint; the broader M4 criterion remains open.

PL-0026 M4b moved the Height Deviation recipe ViewModel state clearing, preview-result assignment, recipe identity/alignment, ROI application, optional Plane Flatness/Volume/Cross-section state, and status sequence from OpenVisionThreeDViewerControl.Recipes.cs into the non-WPF HeightDeviationRecipeApplyCoordinator.cs. The View retains the rendering sample assignment and supplies existing sample-status, ROI, and optional-preview callbacks. Recipe load/apply verification passed 7/7; structure guard passed 53/53; Workbench Docking passed 87/87; Validation Set passed 84/84; Shell and solution Release builds passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors; current-build recipe-apply EXE screenshots passed Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 with screenshot quality accepted on attempt 1. git diff --check passed. This is an M4b checkpoint; the broader M4 criterion remains open for save and later rule/Preview slices.

PL-0026 M4c moved Height Deviation recipe construction, recipe-relative source mapping, persistence, and saved-state/status update from OpenVisionThreeDViewerControl.Recipes.cs into the non-WPF HeightDeviationRecipeSaveCoordinator.cs. The View retains WPF-dependent validation plus source/ROI input and validation-message adaptation. Recipe workflow verification passed 12/12, structure guard passed 54/54, Workbench Docking passed 87/87, Validation Set passed 84/84, Shell and solution Release builds passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, and current-build recipe-save EXE screenshots passed Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 with screenshot quality accepted on attempt 1. Both saved JSON documents parsed successfully; the workflow verifier reloaded the saved recipe and source mapping. git diff --check passed. This is an M4c checkpoint; the broader M4 criterion remains open for M4d rule/Preview or next recipe-family ownership.

PL-0026 M4d moved Height Deviation rule/Preview orchestration out of OpenVisionThreeDViewerControl and into new HeightDeviationRuleCoordinator. The View retains only UI/request/adaptor behavior and now calls coordinator methods for preview state application in the same three trigger points. `dotnet build src/OpenVisionLab.ThreeD.Viewer/OpenVisionLab.ThreeD.Viewer.csproj -v minimal` passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings, `dotnet build OpenVisionLab.ThreeDStudio.sln -c Release -v minimal` passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings, `git diff --check` passed, and direct call-site search confirmed no remaining direct `HeightDeviationRule.Evaluate(...)` usage in Views.

PL-0026 M5 extracted filter execution-state and command ownership into `ToolWorkbenchFilterExecutionOwner`, moving filter/ordered-run state fields and command instances into a concrete owner and leaving `ToolWorkbenchViewModel` wrappers for compatibility. `dotnet build OpenVisionLab.ThreeDStudio.sln -c Debug` passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings, `dotnet build OpenVisionLab.ThreeDStudio.sln -c Release` passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings, `git diff --check` passed.

PL-0026 M6 consolidated Tool Lab lifecycle behavior into `ToolLabWindowBase` and aligned ToolLab XAML roots to inherit the shared base. `dotnet build OpenVisionLab.ThreeDStudio.sln -c Debug` passed with 0 errors/0 warnings, `dotnet build OpenVisionLab.ThreeDStudio.sln -c Release` passed with 0 errors/0 warnings, `git diff --check` passed, and an explicit Tool Lab dedup script check confirmed every `*ToolLabWindow` now inherits `ToolLabWindowBase` with no local `SetLabStep`/`ActivateLabStep` method definitions.
